chunks.schema:
CREATE TABLE chunks (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            pdf_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
            chunk_index INTEGER NOT NULL,
            content TEXT NOT NULL,
            metadata TEXT,
            FOREIGN KEY (pdf_id) REFERENCES pdfs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
        )

messages.schema:
CREATE TABLE messages (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            pdf_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
            role TEXT NOT NULL,
            text TEXT NOT NULL,
            timestamp TEXT DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
            FOREIGN KEY (pdf_id) REFERENCES pdfs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
        )

pdfs.schema:
CREATE TABLE pdfs (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            project_id INTEGER,
            filename TEXT NOT NULL,
            original_filename TEXT NOT NULL,
            filepath TEXT NOT NULL,
            num_chunks INTEGER,
            chunks_stored INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
            upload_ts TEXT DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, sectional_analysis TEXT, processing_status TEXT DEFAULT 'pending', error_message TEXT, remote_id INTEGER, dirty INTEGER DEFAULT 1, last_synced_ts TEXT,
            FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
        )

projects.schema:
CREATE TABLE projects (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
            description TEXT,
            created_ts TEXT DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
        , scheme TEXT, sector TEXT, state TEXT, remote_id INTEGER, dirty INTEGER DEFAULT 1, last_synced_ts TEXT)

sync_metadata.schema:
CREATE TABLE sync_metadata (
            key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            value TEXT
        )

comparison_chat_pdfs.schema:
CREATE TABLE comparison_chat_pdfs (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            comparison_chat_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
            dpr_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
            FOREIGN KEY (comparison_chat_id) REFERENCES comparison_chats (id),
            FOREIGN KEY (dpr_id) REFERENCES dprs (id),
            UNIQUE (comparison_chat_id, dpr_id)
        )

comparison_chats.schema:
CREATE TABLE comparison_chats (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            name TEXT NOT NULL,
            created_ts TEXT NOT NULL
        )

comparison_messages.schema:
CREATE TABLE comparison_messages (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            comparison_chat_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
            role TEXT NOT NULL,
            text TEXT NOT NULL,
            timestamp TEXT NOT NULL,
            FOREIGN KEY (comparison_chat_id) REFERENCES comparison_chats (id)
        )

dprs.schema:
CREATE TABLE dprs (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            project_id INTEGER,
            filename TEXT NOT NULL,
            original_filename TEXT NOT NULL,
            filepath TEXT NOT NULL,
            uploaded_file_ref TEXT NOT NULL,
            upload_ts TEXT NOT NULL,
            summary_json TEXT NOT NULL,
            summary_json_multilang TEXT, local_json TEXT, local_summary INTEGER DEFAULT 0, gemini_summary INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
            FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects (id)
        )

messages.schema:

            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            dpr_id INTEGER NOT NULL,

acquire_write.schema:
CREATE TABLE acquire_write (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
                lock_status INTEGER NOT NULL
            )

collection_metadata.schema:
CREATE TABLE collection_metadata (
    collection_id TEXT REFERENCES collections(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    key TEXT NOT NULL,
    str_value TEXT,
    int_value INTEGER,
    float_value REAL, bool_value INTEGER,
    PRIMARY KEY (collection_id, key)
)

collections.schema:
CREATE TABLE "collections" (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, -- unique globally
    name TEXT NOT NULL, -- unique per database
    dimension INTEGER,
    database_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES databases(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, config_json_str TEXT, schema_str TEXT,
    UNIQUE (name, database_id)
)

databases.schema:
CREATE TABLE databases (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, -- unique globally
    name TEXT NOT NULL, -- unique per tenant
    tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tenants(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    UNIQUE (tenant_id, name) -- Ensure that a tenant has only one database with a given name
)
